prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. A long bread queue in the snow on a 1920s street at dawn: ordinary people of all ages, men and women, Black, white and South Asian, in worn coats, each holding money, a coin, a fistful, a bag, and at the back a wheelbarrow of notes. Sprayed over the photograph with aerosol paint: fluorescent pink and acid yellow overspray clouds, hard-edged stencilled halftone shapes, and long paint drips running down across the coats and the snow, as if someone tagged the photo on a wall. Faces stay real. Camera at waist height from the front of the queue, looking back along it. Light: grey dawn, and one lit shop window full of loaves under a plain blank sign. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
